action: The paper doll stands up, unfolds into a spiral of paper strips and ink smoke that rises and spins, then the strips scatter outward and vanish. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: SHIKIGAMI SUMMON: a cut-paper hitogata doll (a flat human-shaped paper cutout, no face) standing on the ground and unfolding into a big swirl of paper strips and black ink smoke, vermilion stamp marks on the paper, the space above it empty and transparent. Palette: ink black, washi off-white, vermilion, antique gold. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Japanese Heian onmyodo and shrine maiden folk magic style: washi paper talismans with fictional brush strokes, folded paper, black and vermilion lacquer, eerie dignified yokai. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Indonesian, NOT Slavic, NOT anime: no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no glowing crystals, no lightning, no torii gate, no pentagram or star shape, no taiji, no swastika or manji, no rising sun rays, no runes, no readable kanji or text, no religious symbols, no character, no person, no blood, no gore, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are warm washi off-white, never pure white.
